items.title: 7.6 Digital Citizenship and Ethical Considerations (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of digital citizenship (PDF 187-188).

blocks.text: Digital citizenship (digital duniya ka achha shehri hona) ka matlab hai yeh samajhna ke digital technology aur internet istemal karte waqt zimmedari aur ethics (akhlaq, yaani sahi aur ghalat ki tameez) ke saath kaise rehna hai. Is mein woh tamam aadatein aur tareeqe shamil hain jo sab ke liye online tajurba positive (achha) aur mehfooz banate hain. Achhi digital citizenship apna kar log khud ko aur doosron ko nuqsan se bacha sakte hain, doosron ke rights (haq) ki izzat kar sakte hain, aur ek mehfooz aur inclusive (sab ko saath rakhne wala) digital mahaul banane mein hissa daal sakte hain.

Misal: Pakistan mein students ko online forums aur social media par izzat aur tameez se baat karna seekhna chahiye. Is ka matlab hai bullying (dhamkana ya mazaq urana) aur harassment (tang karna) se bachna aur jhooti maloomat na phailana. Is mein digital privacy ki ahmiyat samajhna aur apne online accounts mehfooz rakhna bhi shamil hai ta ke koi baghair ijazat (unauthorized) un tak na pohanche.

blocks.prompt: Achhi digital citizenship ki do misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: Online tameez se comment karna aur kisi ko bully ya harass na karna; aur koi khabar share karne se pehle check karna ke sach hai (jhooti maloomat na phailana). Apna account strong password se mehfooz rakhna bhi is mein shamil hai.

items: Digital citizenship: online zimmedar aur ethical rawayya (behavior); khud ko aur doosron ko bachana, rights ki izzat, mehfooz mahaul.
Tameez se baat, bullying aur jhooti maloomat se parhez, privacy aur accounts ki hifazat.
